title: IIT Madras Summer Fellowship Programme 2027
summary: Two-month summer fellowship with IIT Madras faculty in engineering, sciences, humanities and management.
eligibility: 3rd-year BE/BTech/BSc (Engg), 3rd/4th-year integrated ME/MTech, 1st-year ME/MTech/MSc/MA or MBA students with an outstanding academic record. IIT students are not eligible.

prize.description: ₹6,000 per month for up to two months (last published rate).

notes: The portal historically opens around 20 February, with a 31 March deadline. Confirm the stipend on the 2027 notice.
